steps.title: Inspect Manifest Errors
steps.description: Analyze the manifest merger failure to identify missing package attributes and namespace resolution issues.

steps.title: Fix Android Manifest
steps.description: Add the package namespace attribute directly to the root manifest tag to properly initialize manifest merger context.

steps.title: Verify Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Ensure build.gradle namespace matches the package definition and uses target SDK 34.

steps.title: Check Activity and Keypad Layout
steps.description: Verify MainActivity binding and UI elements match properly with XML view IDs.

steps.title: Verify Sound Player
steps.description: Check synthesize buffer generation and AudioTrack configuration to prevent thread blockages.

steps.title: Verify Mathematical Parser
steps.description: Ensure the recursive descent parser is robust and handles all basic expressions successfully.

steps.title: Validate Sound Controls
steps.description: Validate that sound selection controls work and update UI states properly.

steps.title: Test Live Expression Preview
steps.description: Confirm live evaluation updates results list without crashing on incomplete math input.

steps.title: Verify Android Environment Compatibility
steps.description: Align toolchains and dependencies to compile with SDK 34 and JVM 1.8 compatibility.

steps.title: Building N-Calc
steps.description: Assemble and build the debug APK using standard AGP environment.
